reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, but after that $13 a kid plus gas adds up fast on one income and I have free library and park options. I probably wouldn't pay unless it clicked for us.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and $13 for each kid every visit is a lot when I'm already stretched.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper per-child drop-in around $8 to $9 or a pack that works out to that, since the drive is already a cost.
